reason: Entries to .generic: BNE generic (ds_clip / dm_slot), BCS generic after compiled_part (compiled_none exits before touching ds_c/b_ptr; the unsafe exit, reached from compiled_call's carry set and compiled_direct's fall-through, restores ds_c from ds_n and b_ptr from &C0/&C1), and in SKY_MODE=0 BCS generic after kc_part (no write to &CC/ds_c found in kindcache.6502; ds_c has no other alias). So ds_c = sprite_column_count[sprite] at LDA ds_c, the sprite having passed straight_sprite_hi's BNE known. Sprites with an image (&00-&2F, &33-&35, &37-&4B) have counts 2..12; those with &82 (&32), 0 (&36) and &30/&31 have HI(0) and return early. n-1 in 1..11, so (n-1)<<3 <= &58 and the third ASL shifts out bit 7 of a value < &20 shifted twice, i.e. C = 0, the same as CLC. ADC b_ptr then gives identical A, N, Z, C, V; D unchanged (never set in the renderer); no register or memory other than P differs before CLC and P is overwritten identically. The only exit is STA b_ptr / BCC each or the fall-through, both after ADC. No stack effect; an interrupt between the ASL and ADC saves/restores P, so it sees nothing it reads differently. Recount: CLC is 2 cycles, 1 byte.
